title: Love's Second Chance
description: When Rose inherits her grandmother's vintage dress shop, she runs into her high school crush, Cole, who convinces her to restore the store.

title: Be Mine
description: While preparing to take over her mother's garden store, Catherine works with charming employee Jack to plan a Valentine's Day flower competition. Jack tries to win over the heart of love cynic Catherine.

title: Blueprint to the Heart
description: An interior designer trying to rescue her home renovation show needs to apply her strategy to her carpenter by making him her next project.

title: Calling for Love
description: Successful podcast host Samantha Desouza is passionate about music but cynical about love. That starts to change when she meets Jake, a charismatic and charming new caller whom she tries to help with a problem.

title: Love on Harbor Island
description: Interior designer Lily returns home to help her Aunt Maggie run her marina-side bed and breakfast when she meets Marcus, a handsome seaplane pilot whose work delivering rescue dogs helps Lily discover that home really is where the heart is.

title: Killer Reputation
description: A public relations maven takes pride in her low profile and reputation, but she risks both to help a fading action star accused of killing his ex-wife. She believes he's innocent because she knows him better than most.

title: Hometown Hero
description: After being forced to look after her client's dog, a cynical divorce mediator begins to have a change of heart. Thanks to the dog, she begins to spend more time with the local vet, and she begins to find that true love may not be so far away.

title: Cooking With Love
description: Optimistic and cheerful TV producer Kelly doesn't have time for love, while bad boy celebrity chef Stephen doesn't have time for anything besides cooking. When Kelly and Stephen are paired on a children's cooking show, fun with a side of love ensues.

title: Dying for the Crown
description: A successful, married woman is thrown into turmoil when she reunites with an old school friend.

title: Kill Thy Neighbor
description: Years after the death of her husband, Julie Caster moves across the country to start a new life with her young son, only to realise that someone carries a dangerous obsession with her and her son.

title: Pretty Little Stalker
description: A troubled young girl grows obsessed with the author of a series of self-help books, who has recently become her neighbour.
